verdict.rationale: Check documents deleting a payroll object as part of the create/preview/approve/delete lifecycle, and its CLI exposes `cancel` and `refund` on payments; voids are also listed as a feature. Together these show a first-party way to stop or reverse payroll money movement. The evidence does not say whether a payroll can be deleted or edited once approved and submitted, nor how cutoff timing relative to payday works. missing for 10: explicit cancel/edit of an approved payroll before payday, correction/update workflow for submitted payrolls, cutoff-timing details, independent corroboration.
